description.value: The Chesterfield is a full-service brunch and dinner restaurant in downtown Revelstoke, formerly operating as Chubby Funsters. The kitchen leans into elevated comfort food with locally sourced greens from First Light Farms, house-made pastas, and BC-focused wine and craft beer lists. Outdoor seating is available, and the central MacKenzie Avenue location puts it squarely on the route for cyclists passing through town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active sit-down restaurant at 114 MacKenzie Ave, Revelstoke, BC with phone 250 837 2014, matching the OSM address. The dinner and brunch menus include numerous items explicitly marked (veg), (vegan/gf), and (gf), confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
